text:
DOSL7::profile
Description
This command returns the DOS profile from which the L7-DoS policy is
extracted.
Note:
in 11.4, default policy returns empty string and if L7-DoS is
disabled, the <no-profile> string is returned.
in 11.5+, default policy returns the one configured with the vip
and if L7-DoS is disabled, a null string is returned.
Introduced: BIGIP-11.4.0
